title: Sam's Picture Cards

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: The book arrived! Sam was so happy, he read three stories before lunch.

intro.speaker: greta
intro.text: Now he's made picture cards to go with the new stories, for the little ones. Will you help him label them?

steps.speaker: greta
steps.prompt: Put each label under the picture it names. Tap a picture to hear its name.
steps.hint: Listen to the first sound of the word. Which label starts with that sound?

older.prompt: Read each word, and put it under its picture. One word doesn't belong here!

feedback.wrong: Listen again. Does that sound match?
feedback.all_good: Every card is labelled. The little ones will love them!

outro.speaker: greta
outro.text: Sam says thank you! He's going to read the animal stories to the little ones every afternoon.

journal_line: I helped Sam label picture cards in Bellhaven's library.
